Proposition
[Lie derivative in the direction $fX$]

Source: petersen:page-0063, petersen:page-0064 ↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor-formula

1. ch2:2.1.4If $T$ is a $(0,k)$-tensor and $f:M\to \mathbb {R}$, then \[ (L_{fX}T)(Y_1,\dots ,Y_k) = f(L_XT)(Y_1,\dots ,Y_k)+\sum _{i=1}^k(L_{Y_i}f)\, T(Y_1,\dots ,X,\dots ,Y_k), \] with $X$ replacing $Y_i$ in the $i$th slot.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-scaling

\sketch Insert $D_{fX}=fD_X$ and

\[ [fX,Y_i]=f[X,Y_i]-(D_{Y_i}f)X \]

into subsection 1.2. Multilinearity separates the terms multiplied by $f$, which form $fL_XT$, from the correction in each slot, giving the asserted sum.

□
